# Évasion Gusto

> Private chef, catering and cooking-class services based in Beaumont, Belgium, serving the Hainaut and Namur provinces.

Évasion Gusto provides private chef services at the client's home, catering for events, takeout gourmet meals, cooking classes, culinary workshops, wine and beer tastings, and corporate team-building workshops (cheese-making, brewing, charcuterie).

## Service area
Beaumont, Chimay, Mons, Thuin, Thuilies, Charleroi, Sivry, Rance, Namur, Brussels, Lobbes, Erquelinnes, Merbes-le-Château, Froidchapelle, Ham-sur-Heure-Nalinnes, Momignies, Anderlues, Walcourt, Philippeville, Florennes, Cerfontaine, Couvin, La Louvière, Binche, Solre-sur-Sambre, and the wider Hainaut and Namur provinces, Belgium.
